message:
4 helper(s) imported from a relative module under a name no vocabulary can match:
      sheen.spec.ts:2 — `styleOf`, imported from `./support/css`: no file of the corpus answers for `./support/css`
      swatch.spec.ts:2 — `styleOf`, imported from `./support`: no file of the corpus answers for `./css`
      tint.spec.ts:3 — `styleOf`, imported from `./support/paint`: no file of the corpus answers for `./css`
      toast.spec.ts:2 — `styleOf`, imported from `./support/css`: no file of the corpus answers for `./support/css`
    Every
why: `support/css.ts` gone, as in `reader-dropped`, and a `styleOf` still in the corpus — in `support/legacy.ts`, where it names a property and reads nothing. A name held to the whole pool finds that one and is satisfied, while every spec takes `styleOf` from `./support/css`: directly, through the index's `export *`, or through `support/paint.ts`, which re-exports it by name. Each import is followed to the file its module names, and the last step finds no `./css`. Through the index, `visit` is found by the star to `./dom` while the star to `./css` is not held — one star that answers is enough, and a name that only an unheld star could answer is reported as unheld rather than as missing.
